summary: Added fees ($44 midweek 2-night to $105; none stored), 50-amp/W/S, 97 RV sites to 53 ft, 21 pull-through, 2-night online minimum, military 15%. Old 'from $38' removed from the note.
flags: PRICE GATE passes on midweek only, and the $44 needs a human eye: 30-amp W/E is $43.85 a night on two-night Tue-Thu stays in May, July and September 2027 but $85 a night on a June weekend; the undated list shows $78-105 for RV sites. The midweek row also shows $85 with $44 beside it, so $44 reads as a discount off $85, and it could be a promotion rather than a standing rate. Service fees are extra. If $44 is a promotion, the real night is $78-85 and this is a DROP CANDIDATE on price: no gateway within 40 km (Point Pelee NP 131 km), and not a Good Sam Park (directory gs false; stored good_sam is absent).
Google Maps: Adventure Bound Camping Resorts - Pleasant View, 3.7 from 386 reviews, (419) 299-3897, abcamping.com. Low rating, not very poor.
2-night online minimum: stored as a standing minimum because the engine says so on every RV row; one night is possible by phone, so it isn't a multi-night-only drop.

Booking engine sells cabins, tents and RV sites with no membership gate; Adventure Bound Rewards (10% off stays under 28 days) is optional. Seasonal programme exists; 97 of the RV sites sell online, and test 4 is not evidenced against a total.

Facilities: the pages read list resort amenities but don't state showers, flush toilets, laundry or dump for campers, left unset. Season dates aren't stated either ('Storage runs from the end of the current season'), left unset.
